card.stem: Use the original ground-floor and rear-garden plan of the two-storey semi-detached house. Its external walls are 400 mm concrete block with a full-fill insulated cavity, and rear wall M–M faces south. The owners need an additional study and occasional family space with internal dimensions 5.0 m × 3.0 m. Option A is a single-storey extension attached to the rear of the house at A; option B is a detached, free-standing room in the garden at B. Part (a) compares BOTH options. Part (b) selects ONE option for the external design, internal layout and link to the surrounding rear garden. Part (c) discusses two advantages of linking the room and garden.
card.questionText: Discuss in detail two advantages of the attached extension at A.

rows.verbatim: conserves space in the rear garden of the house
rows.contextNote: Award two distinct, relevant advantages at 3 marks each (6 total). Source examples include conserving rear-garden space; reducing external-wall area and associated insulation costs; easier connection to existing services; flexible division of the combined living space; and closer family/social connection. Discuss each point in relation to this house and location; do not count a repeated point twice. Other relevant, well-argued points remain acceptable. This narrowed practice task retains its own 6 marks; the full comparison requires all four pairs.

Its external walls are 400 mm concrete block with a full-fill insulated cavity, and rear wall M–M faces south. The owners need an additional study and occasional family space with internal dimensions 5.0 m × 3.0 m. Option A is a single-storey extension attached to the rear of the house at A; option B is a detached, free-standing room in the garden at B. Part (a) compares BOTH options. Part (b) selects ONE option for the external design, internal layout and link to the surrounding rear garden. Part (c) discusses two advantages of linking the room and garden.
card.questionText: For option B, a detached, free-standing garden room at B, use notes and freehand sketches to show the proposed internal layout of the 5.0 m × 3.0 m study/family space.

rows.verbatim: the space is divided to provide some privacy and a sense of seclusion
rows.contextNote: Internal-layout notes 6 and sketches 6 (12 total). Place the separate room at B in the rear garden and keep the specified 5.0 m × 3.0 m internal space; do not move it into the attached-extension position A. The source describes a small desk/office area for individual work and a larger communal area, with separation giving privacy; a convertible couch is an optional example, not a required bedroom. Show a workable internal arrangement for the stated study and occasional family uses, with access and circulation related to the original plan. The source plan is illustrative: do not require its exact furniture arrangement or copy it at the expense of the printed dimensions. External form and garden-link marks are awarded in their own tasks.
